bullets.text: CLSA keeps Hindalco O-PF, TP Rs1,240: EBITDA guided to more than double by FY32, Novelis Bay Minette to 5mt+ at $600/t.
bullets.source: CLSA - CLSA India Research - Larsen & Toubro| Adani Ports| Hindalco| Mahindra Finance| India Consumer Durables

detail.summary: CLSA hosted Hindalco at IF26; management laid out an FY32 EBITDA-doubling path from Novelis debottlenecking, India upstream capacity and coal projects even at LME $2,750, and downstream EBITDA rising sharply from a thin base.
points: EBITDA to more than double by FY32 vs FY26
India upstream EBITDA to double, even at LME $2,750
Novelis net debt to peak by 4QFY27; consol leverage <2x

bullets.text: JPM: LME aluminium range-bound $3,100-3,300/t for 3 months; Hindalco investor feedback mixed with no clear catalyst, still a JPM top pick.
bullets.source: JPM - India Metals & Logistics: India Conference takeaways & investor feedback. Key theme: Steel > Aluminum

detail.summary: JPM's investor-conference wrap says aluminium sentiment is directionless - LME range-bound with no positive catalyst - and Hindalco feedback was mixed even as JPM keeps it a top pick; Novelis scrap spreads are seen weakening as new capacity ramps.
points: Hindalco: mixed, cautiously optimistic investor feedback
No catalyst - Fed, Section 232 tariff delay, Indonesia ramp
Novelis scrap spreads to weaken on new US capacity ramps
JPM top picks: JSW Steel, Hindalco, Exide, Aegis

bullets.text: BNP trims 2026/27E China aluminium to RMB24,000/22,000/t but sees a 2027 global deficit, against the Street's oversupply view.
bullets.source: BNP Paribas - BNPP INDIA QUICK NOTES: VOLT - Buying opportunity | ... | CHINA ALUMNIUM - Looking good

detail.summary: BNP Paribas argues the Street is too bearish on supply, expecting a 2027 deficit versus consensus oversupply, while trimming its own price forecasts and flagging that current stock prices already imply even lower spot aluminium.
points: Expects 2027 supply deficit vs Street oversupply
Middle East, Indonesia supply seen slower

bullets.text: Domestic HRC at its highest since mid-2022 while coking coal futures start declining; JPM's investors prefer steel to aluminium, top pick JSW Steel.
bullets.source: JPM - India Metals & Logistics: India Conference takeaways & investor feedback. Key theme: Steel > Aluminum

detail.summary: JPM's India conference takeaways find investors favouring steel over aluminium, with HRC rallying to multi-year highs even as coking coal costs rose; JPM argues the coal spike is cyclical and is already being offset by higher steel prices, with Tata Steel's European DRI-EAF plans back in focus.
points: HRC prices highest since mid-2022, rally continuing
Coking coal costs surged, futures now declining
3QFY27 coal cost impact largely offset by steel prices
JPM top picks: JSW Steel, Hindalco, Exide, Aegis

bullets.text: Elara flags steel prices at a 4-year high, expecting the uptrend to continue through H2.
bullets.source: Elara - Elara Stinger: EV, CNG gain ground as auto fuel mix steadily shifts

bullets.text: Welspun Corp's associate won a Rs2,000cr Aramco steel-pipe contract, while China's steel industry weakened further in Aug-26.
bullets.source: Kotak - Basic materials - daily news and prices

detail.summary: Kotak's daily wrap pairs a large Middle East order win with soft Chinese steel data: Gulf infrastructure demand for pipe versus continued domestic demand weakness in China.
points: Rs2,000cr Aramco steel-pipe contract to Welspun associate
China steel industry weakened further in Aug-26
China domestic demand under pressure, per BigMint

bullets.text: All-India cement prices +2.2% mom in Sep-26, led by East +3.5% and South +3.0%; Kotak stays cautious, prefers Nuvoco.
bullets.source: Kotak - [Kotak] Construction Materials: Prices firm up, trail cost pressures

detail.summary: Kotak's channel checks show all-India cement prices firming on receding monsoons and renewed hike attempts, with East and South leading after a weak August. It still expects festive-season seasonality (3Q qoq average -0.5% over 25 years) to cap further large hikes.
points: Nuvoco top pick, sub-$60 EV/ton FY2028E

bullets.text: Kotak sees ~3-4% downside to FY27E consensus EBITDA with petcoke/coal 33%/28% above pre-war levels; Ramco (TRCL) top SELL.
bullets.source: Kotak - [Kotak] Construction Materials: Prices firm up, trail cost pressures

detail.summary: Kotak argues persistent cost inflation from the Middle East conflict is pushing margin recovery further out, with diesel up 8-9% since May-26 on top of elevated petcoke and coal; valuations offer limited upside given the earnings pressure.
points: 2QFY27E margins likely down qoq on lagged costs

bullets.text: Sep MTD power demand +14.7% YoY and coal generation +17.2% YoY, with a record September peak of 269GW - supportive for Coal India offtake.

detail.summary: Nuvama's tracker (data to 21 Sep) shows power demand and coal-fired generation both running well ahead of last year, with September peak demand the highest ever recorded for the month and IEX spot prices sharply higher.

bullets.text: Voltas holds off RAC price hikes despite RM headwinds, absorbing cost via channel-scheme cuts; Kotak cuts FY27-29E EPS 6-9% - pricing flag for Amber/PGEL.
bullets.source: Kotak - Kotak : Curious case INDUSTOW vs IDEA; INITIATE SHADOWFAX ADD; Jubilant Ingrevia - On track ; Voltas - No cheer; 360 one - Mgmt Meet (+4 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: Voltas will offset commodity inflation through cuts to channel margins and promotional schemes rather than a headline price hike, despite 15-20% industry secondary RAC growth and continued share gains. Kotak trims fair value to Rs1,070 - a caution on pricing power across the room-AC value chain.
points: No headline price hike despite RM headwinds
Cost absorbed via channel margin and scheme cuts

bullets.text: Kotak stays BUY on TechM, FV Rs1,750, after the CEO chat: turnaround called structural, demand steady with no signs of deterioration.
bullets.source: Kotak - [Kotak] Tech Mahindra (CMP: Rs1,557, FV: Rs1,750, BUY): Building the enterprise of the future

detail.summary: Kotak hosted CEO Mohit Joshi and CFO Rohit Anand and concludes the turnaround's hard yards are done, with focus shifting to sustaining momentum. TechM has defended telecom wallet share through vendor consolidation and positions for AI-led spend via a senior-heavy talent structure; automotive stays weak.
points: 92% of revenue on one common ERP platform
6-7% of annual revenue from new clients
45-50% productivity now demanded over 5-year deals, from 35-40%

bullets.text: IIFL upgrades Tata Technologies to BUY, TP Rs840 from Rs780, on converted vehicle-program wins and the $100mn+ Tenneco ramp.
bullets.source: IIFL - IIFL: The Front Page: Banking; NBFC; Insurance; Auto; TATATECH; VMM

detail.summary: IIFL argues Tata Technologies' deal engine is firing: two full-vehicle-program wins converted, four more in the pipeline, plus the Tenneco ramp. It forecasts 15-16.6% cc revenue growth and 22% EPS growth over FY26-28, among the fastest in its IT coverage.
points: Two full-vehicle-program deals converted; four in pipeline

bullets.text: US 10Y +14bp to 5.11% and Brent +4.6% to $103.59 on a hot September PMI and Iran rhetoric; JPM turns tactically cautious.
bullets.source: JPM - JPM Overnight Brief! 9/24 - Sep PMI drove a sharp spike in bond yields, stock lower

detail.summary: A hot September flash composite PMI showed the largest monthly input-cost jump since 2020, triggering a broad bond selloff alongside a fresh leg up in Brent on Iran/Hormuz tension and a weak 5Y auction. JPM flags hawkish Fedspeak and Middle East escalation as this week's key risks.
points: Composite PMI cost inflation worst since 2020

bullets.text: MSCI Nov-26 review: BNP rates LICI and Coforge HIGH-probability standard-index adds (~$501mn/~$579mn flows); PI Industries flagged for deletion.
bullets.source: BNP Paribas - BNP PARIBAS INDIA INDEX PERISCOPE | MSCI November 2026 Review

detail.summary: BNP's index-flow desk assigns high probability to LICI (fresh add) and Coforge (small-to-standard migration), while PI Industries and ICICI Prudential Life carry deletion risk; Biocon and Meesho sit mid-to-high pending price action into the cutoff.
points: ICICI Pru Life: mid-to-high deletion risk, -$188mn

bullets.text: India's official gold imports have fallen sharply since May-26; Kotak sees a CAD/BoP benefit but warns of diversion to unofficial channels.
bullets.source: Kotak - [Kotak] Strategy: Sharp decline in reported gold imports—good, bad or ugly? (+7 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: Kotak frames the unexplained drop as a genuine demand reset, a pause ahead of feared duty cuts, or diversion to unofficial channels that would understate true imports and cost GST/customs revenue.
points: 13-May-26 duty hike lifted domestic gold ~9% over global
Kotak repeats call for higher GST, lower duty

bullets.text: Exide commissioned its 6GWh lithium-ion cell plant on 23-Sep, in homologation with three 2W EV OEMs covering 80-85% of the market.
bullets.source: JPM - Exide Industries: Lithium ion cell manufacturing facility commissioned; details awaited

detail.summary: The plant went live in line with 1Q commentary that revenue starts in 3QFY27; customer names remain undisclosed. JPM stays Overweight, PT Rs514, with the stock down 13% since its 12-Aug peak.

bullets.text: JSW Group enters electric CVs targeting ~100,000 units of capacity by 2030; govt to weigh auto PLI applications with Chinese investment.
bullets.source: Elara - Elara Stinger: EV, CNG gain ground as auto fuel mix steadily shifts

detail.summary: Trade-press items compiled in Elara's digest and Kotak's auto wrap: JSW's entry into electric commercial mobility, Nexperia's India expansion with Tata after losing its China unit, and a PLI window for Chinese-invested auto applicants.
points: JSW new entrant in electric CVs
Nexperia expands into India with Tata
Auto PLI applications with Chinese investment under review

bullets.text: IRDAI's Sept-26 paper cuts expense-of-management limits and caps commissions from FY28; NBFC credit-protect distributors (LTF) hit hardest, SBI Life best placed.
bullets.source: PhillipCapital - IRDAI Distribution Reforms – Consultation Paper Sept'26 | First cut - PhillipCapital India (+7 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: The two-part paper combines hard commission caps with lower EOM limits (life to 12.5% in five years, general insurance to 20% from 30%), phased from FY28 with comments due 25-Oct. Brokers see NBFC credit-life distributors worst hit and SBI Life, HDFC Life, ICICI Lombard and Star Health best placed.

ai_semis.text: Broadcom -2.6% overnight on reports China may steer data centres away from its hardware toward domestic chips.
ai_semis.source: JPM - Overnight Brief 9/24 - Sep PMI drove a sharp spike in bond yields, stock lower

ai_semis.text: GS sees the AI-driven battery backup unit market growing 23x to $50.2bn by 2030; raises Panasonic HD TP to Y6,300.
ai_semis.source: Goldman Sachs - [GS Daily] ... Panasonic TP raise on BBU market expansion ...

ai_semis.text: Meta's Muse AI agent hit #1 on the App Store, driving Meta's largest monthly share-price move since 2013.
